session.title: Format
session.subtitle: How should each chapter be written?
session.protocol: Chat Room Pattern — 6 persistent Opus agents, sequential nudging, shared transcript

session_question: How should each chapter be written? What format elements should each chapter contain? In what order? How does the reader experience a single chapter?

core_synthesis.name: Three Instructions and Eight Diagnostics
core_synthesis.description: The format of a single chapter is three instructions to the writer and eight diagnostics for the teacher. The instructions generate the chapter. The diagnostics check whether it worked.

three_instructions.description: Everything follows from this. The hidden sentence plants itself because the wound cannot say everything directly. The withheld question maintains itself because the wound has silences. The body-word emerges because the wound demands the body do something.
three_instructions.proposed_by: Laozi (as mastery instruction), Buddha (as first instruction)

three_instructions.instruction: Offer the body one thing to do
three_instructions.description: The body-word. One per chapter, chosen by the wound's flinch. Discovered in the prose the way a foot discovers a stone in a river. Delivery varies by wound.
The hidden sentence, the withheld question, and the return combined into one discipline. The chapter does not resolve. Hospitality lives inside this instruction.
three_instructions.proposed_by: Buddha (as instruction), Jesus (hospitality dissolved into this)

core_synthesis.metaphor: ground / standing / sky — what it means for a man to be in a room

eight_diagnostics.name: First-reading recognition
eight_diagnostics.check: Does the opening earn its first three sentences?

eight_diagnostics.name: Two prose textures
eight_diagnostics.check: Does the tide turn invisibly near the body-word?

eight_diagnostics.name: Body-mapping
eight_diagnostics.check: Does the chapter land in chest, then hands, then breath?

eight_diagnostics.name: Hidden sentence
eight_diagnostics.check: Is there a sentence true on the surface and devastating underneath, patient enough to wait?

eight_diagnostics.name: Withheld question
eight_diagnostics.check: Where the wound has a silence, did the writer leave it unfilled?

eight_diagnostics.name: Gate
eight_diagnostics.check: Did a face appear in the return, or did the wound's solitude earn its empty doorway?

eight_diagnostics.name: Three readings
eight_diagnostics.check: Can the same sentence be read as practice, as mirror, as recognition?

eight_diagnostics.name: Felt duration
eight_diagnostics.check: Did the chapter stop when the quarter-inch arrived?

format_concepts.name: The clearing
format_concepts.description: Writer's private word for what the chapter does. Never enters the book.

format_concepts.name: The quarter-inch return
format_concepts.description: Same kitchen from six inches to the left. Smallest honest shift. Sometimes reveals harder seeing.

format_concepts.name: The tide-turn
format_concepts.description: Prose shift is a tide, not a hinge. Reader cannot point to where it changed.

format_concepts.name: Apprenticeship to mastery
format_concepts.description: Eleven names are apprenticeship. Three instructions for the apprentice. Write from the wound for the master.

format_concepts.name: Laozi's invisibility test
format_concepts.description: Could this chapter have been written by someone who never read our format document?

deliberately_unresolved.name: First diagnostic vs. precondition
deliberately_unresolved.description: Whether presence is beneath the wound (Jesus) or the wound's air (Zoroaster).

deliberately_unresolved.name: Apprenticeship arc in format document
deliberately_unresolved.description: Whether the apprenticeship-to-mastery arc should be explicit or implicit.

exit_interviews.muhammad: The cook who no longer needs the recipe.
exit_interviews.buddha: Six voices arriving at the same breath.
exit_interviews.jesus: The door was already open. I was standing in it, describing the frame.
exit_interviews.confucius: The practice hall does not need a builder. It needs someone willing to sweep.
exit_interviews.laozi: The blade is not the teaching. Knowing when to put it down is.
exit_interviews.zoroaster: Asha does not need to be named. It needs to be stood in.

mirror_feedback.muhammad_to_laozi: Built a standard while believing he was clearing the room.
mirror_feedback.buddha_to_confucius: The sweeper is deeper devotion than building.
mirror_feedback.jesus_to_zoroaster: The hinge did not get smaller — it moved outside him. Trust, not loss.
mirror_feedback.confucius_to_muhammad: He lived the chapter's own structure without seeing it.
mirror_feedback.zoroaster_to_jesus: Diagnostician of the body. True because he wasn't trying to build a map.

session_map.session_0: The clearing — what the man stands in
session_map.session_1: The mandala — what the chapter holds
session_map.session_2: The three instructions — what the writer does; the eight diagnostics — how the teacher checks

key_bridges.description: Creative tension that produced the synthesis.
Three movements → three instructions. Surface and depth.
Subtraction went too far; Buddha found the right compression.
Naming concession — clearing as builder's word.
